name: v10.7.0
body:
## v10.7.0 (2026-09-22)

_This release is published under the MIT License._

### ✨ Features

- **cmd-stamp**: Expand version stamp mechanism to support typed python variables ([PR#1485](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/pull/1485), [`947c57b`](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/commit/947c57b48bee85753cf40296b98529da26bf4b58))

- **cmd-version**: Add optional `git --signoff` to version commits ([PR#1492](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/pull/1492), [`3cecbeb`](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/commit/3cecbebb9a87ff6adf46e9334f18bd9c84655608))

### 📖 Documentation

- **configuration**: Added `signoff_commit` setting definition ([PR#1492](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/pull/1492), [`3cecbeb`](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/commit/3cecbebb9a87ff6adf46e9334f18bd9c84655608))

- **configuration**: Document Python type annotation support for `version_variables` ([PR#1485](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/pull/1485), [`947c57b`](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/commit/947c57b48bee85753cf40296b98529da26bf4b58))

### ⚙️ Build System

- **deps**: Correct `click` range specification for python3.10+ ([PR#1486](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/pull/1486), [`e4b3bad`](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/commit/e4b3badb127b751d4946ccd7efb3ec0e8c159895))

- **deps**: Expand `click` dependency range to include `v8.5.*` ([PR#1489](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/pull/1489), [`fa87c95`](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/commit/fa87c95ffbdaae3b7516dcc355e57bd5f4632c1f))

### 💡 Additional Release Information

- **cmd-version**: With this release, we added a boolean flag, `semantic_release.signoff_commit`, as an available configuration option to toggle the addition of the `Signed-off-by` git trailer/footer message to release commits made by Python Semantic Release. Default is currently set to `False` but if you want to try this option, set this configuration setting to `True`. In a future major release, this setting will be set to `True` by default.

### ✅ Resolved Issues

- [#1441](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/issues/1441): _feat: add option to signoff commits made by python-semantic-release_

- [#1443](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/issues/1443): _feat: extend `version_variables` to replace vars with python type annotations_

---

**Detailed Changes**: [v10.6.2...v10.7.0](https://github.com/python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release/compare/v10.6.2...v10.7.0)
